In the ⋯ menu, or in More… on a device, tap File tools. Merge PDFs puts two or more PDFs together in the order you choose. Resize pictures makes photos smaller (for example 1920 px) as JPEG or WebP. Then send the result to a device or save it. Everything happens on your device.

In More… on a device, tap Safety code. Both devices show the same 12 digits when you are connected straight to each other; tap Show it on the other device too to compare. If the codes are different, don't send anything and connect again.

In More… on a device, tap Whiteboard. The other device is asked to open it, then you both draw on the same board at once, with 6 colours, 3 sizes and an eraser. Undo takes back your last line, Clear empties it for both, and Save picture keeps a PNG.
Back up new photos by themselves:

On the phone, tap your computer, then More… and Back up photos, and turn on Back up new photos by themselves. On Android, pick the camera folder once (DCIM, then Camera): new photos go to the computer's backup folder whenever OmniBeam is open on both. On iPhone a one-tap card offers the backup when the computer is online.
